title: Wire LFU into evaluate()

acceptance_criteria: Cache populated after first poll; reflects updated list entries after subsequent polls

title: LFU frequency tracker
design: Track evaluate() call frequency per context_key within window duration. Maintain hot set of top-capacity context keys.
acceptance_criteria: Hot set correctly identifies most-frequent contexts within window; evicts stale entries

title: evaluate() core — rule-based segments + list-check fallback

acceptance_criteria: evaluate() returns correct variant; rule-based makes no network calls; list-based makes exactly 1 API call

title: SdkClient::init() + background polling task
